versions.changelog: Round 24: deep fragmentation analysis and redundancy governance

anygen-diagram-generator-free 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- First public version providing free text-to-diagram generation using AnyGen CLI and www.anygen.io backend.
- Supports basic diagram types: flowcharts, system architecture diagrams, and sequence diagrams.
- Offers smart_draw automatic diagram type/layout selection from plain text, with images rendered server-side.
- Requires installation of AnyGen CLI and anygen-workflow-generate skill; operates via API Key authentication.
- Best suited for rapid technical documentation, workflow visualization, and basic diagram needs.
